mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.tenant_id AS tenantId, r.role_code AS roleCode, r.role_name AS roleName, r.description, r.status, r.created_by AS createdBy, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.updated_by AS updatedBy, r.updated_at AS updatedAt, r.isdel FROM auth_role r INNER JOIN auth_user_role ur ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.isdel = 0 AND ur.isdel = 0 ORDER BY r.created_at ASC

SELECT r.role_code FROM auth_role r INNER JOIN auth_user_role ur ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.isdel = 0 AND ur.isdel = 0 ORDER BY r.created_at ASC

SELECT DISTINCT u.id, u.tenant_id AS tenantId, u.user_no AS userNo, u.username, u.password_hash AS passwordHash, u.real_name AS realName, u.email, u.phone, u.status, u.created_by AS createdBy, u.created_at AS createdAt, u.updated_by AS updatedBy, u.updated_at AS updatedAt, u.isdel FROM auth_user u
INNER JOIN auth_user_role ur ON u.id = ur.user_id AND ur.isdel = 0
WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.isdel = 0
AND u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.username}, '%')
AND u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.realName}, '%')
AND u.user_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.userNo}, '%')
AND u.status = #{req.status}
AND ur.role_id = #{req.roleId} AND ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
ORDER BY u.created_at DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) FROM auth_user u INNER JOIN auth_user_role ur ON u.id = ur.user_id AND ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.isdel = 0 INNER JOIN auth_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id AND r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.isdel = 0 WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.isdel = 0 AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (r.role_code = 'tenant.admin' OR r.role_code = 'TENANT_ADMIN')
